entries.en: Guildmaster Geva requires your assistance due to an unanticipated setback.
entries.fr: Geva, à la guilde des tanneurs, a un travail important à vous confier.
entries.ja: 革細工師ギルドのゲヴァは、冒険者に、ある重要な仕事を任せようとしている。

entries.en: You have been instructed to make a pair of hard leather caligae and a hard leather choker in place of a fellow guild member who has run away. Craft the two items and present them to Geva for inspection.
entries.fr: Geva a besoin de vous pour remplacer un tanneur qui a abandonné son travail. Il faut que vous fabriquiez  et .
entries.ja: 仕事を放棄して逃げ出した革細工師の代わりに、「」と「」をひとつずつ作り、革細工師ギルドの「ゲヴァ」に届けよう。

entries.en: Despite your best efforts, your caligae and choker are not quite up to Fen-Yll standards. Geva must make additional adjustments, which means the delivery will be delayed. Geva asks that you /kneel in apology before the customer, a gentleman by the name of Sosobati, who awaits in the reception area.

entries.en:
Much to your relief, Sosobati turns out to be an understanding fellow. He believes that Geva favors you highly, even if her words may not always make this wholly apparent. Taking the episode's lessons to heart, you continue to apply yourself to mastering your craft.

※The next leatherworker quest will be available from Geva upon reaching level 20.

entries.fr:
Vous avez présenté vos excuses à Sosobati pour le retard de la commande. Il semble convaincu que Geva apprécie votre travail et qu'elle vous fait confiance. Il va falloir continuer à vous perfectionner dans l'art de la tannerie si vous ne voulez pas la décevoir.
* Geva propose la prochaine quête aux tanneurs de niveau 20.
entries.ja:
依頼人のソソバチ曰く、ゲヴァは冒険者のことを買っているらしい。中々そうは見えないが、彼女の期待に応えるためにも、今回の経験を活かし、いっそう革細工師の鍛錬に励もう。

※革細工師のレベルが20以上になると、ゲヴァから次の革細工師クエストを受注することができます。

entries.en: To explain the situation, I had entrusted the commission to another leatherworker, but found the quality of his work so wholly unacceptable that I had no choice but to demand that he start again. Naturally, I gave the fellow a sound dressing-down, reminding him that he had dishonored the name of Fen-Yll and so on, only for him to run off, bawling, leaving a trail of snot and tears in his wake!

entries.en: Needless to say, I was more than a little concerned─after all, there was a very real possibility that I was going to have to keep a customer waiting. But thanks to your timely arrival, everything will be put to rights.
entries.fr: J'avais demandé à un autre tanneur de me les fabriquer, mais les objets qu'il m'a remis n'étaient ni faits ni à faire. Je lui ai dit ma façon de penser, et le bougre est parti en claquant la porte. Certaines personnes sont d'une susceptibilité, je te jure...
entries.ja:
別の革細工師に製作を任せてたんだけど、
出来があまりに酷いから、ちょっと文句をつけたら、
逃げ出しちゃって。

entries.ja:
代わりに任せられそうな革細工師を探していたのよ。
あんた、やれるわよね？

entries.macro: This will be your first task undertaken for Fen<-->Yll Fineries.
entries.fr: Même si tu pourras difficilement faire pire, tu as plutôt intérêt à faire de ton mieux, car ce que tu vas confectionner sera vendu comme sortant de notre atelier.
entries.ja:
ああ、大切なことを言い忘れてたわ。
これは、工芸「フェン・イル」に依頼された品よ。

あんたも腕を上げたみたいだし、
そろそろ、ひと仕事、任せてみようってわけ。
革細工師ギルドの名にかけて、失敗のできない仕事よ。

entries.en: ...What is it? Troubled by the crushing weight of expectation?
entries.fr: Hmm ? Tu as l'air inqui. Tu as peur de ne pas être à la hauteur ?
entries.ja:
不安になった？
「フェン・イル」の名を背負う、自信がない？

entries.en: Well, you may cast your fears aside. You've done yourself credit thus far, carrying out my instructions with nary a complaint and taking all my criticism on the chin. I know that you won't shame us.
entries.fr: Ne sois pas stupide, je suis bien placée pour savoir ce que tu vaux. Tu as toujours fait ce que je t'avais demandé, et sans jamais te plaindre.
entries.ja:
大丈夫、しっかりしなさい。
散々アタシにしごかれて逃げ出さなかったのよ。
あんたの根性は、アタシが一番知ってるわ。

entries.en: And even should the worst come to the worst, I know you'll have the good grace to go before the customer and apologize in person.
entries.fr: J'ai donc toute confiance en toi : si tes produits ne sont pas bons, je sais que tu iras t'excuser auprès du client sans rechigner.

entries.en: As you know, this type of leather is valued for its toughness and durability. Yet these same qualities make it troublesome to work.
entries.fr: Je te l'ai déjà dit auparavant, la principale qualité du cuir rigide est sa dureté. Mais c'est aussi ce qui le rend difficile à plier et à coudre.
entries.ja:
知ってのとおり、ハードレザーは硬さがウリよ。
だからこそ、丈夫な製品ができるわけだけど、
曲げたり縫ったりするのも難しいってわけ。

entries.en: An inexperienced leatherworker often ruins the material with shoddy stitching and poor molding, resulting in a final product that is misshapen, brittle, and liable to fall apart.
entries.fr: Un artisan maladroit peut aisément l'abîmer durant la confection et le rendre complètement impropre à servir de protection.
entries.ja:
下手な職人では、加工の途中で失敗して、
最大の利点である「丈夫さ」を殺してしまうことがあるわ。

entries.en: Your caligae and choker, however, bear none of the hallmarks of amateurism. Your construction is solid, and your leather has retained its strength.
entries.fr: Je vois que ça n'a pas été ton cas. Tu as su conserver la robustesse du cuir durant la fabrication.
entries.ja:
でもこのカリガとチョーカーは、
ちゃんと革の性質を見極めて加工してる。
だから、素材の持つ「丈夫さ」が保たれているわ。

entries.en: ...But you still have some way to go. The clasps aren't securely fastened, and the stitching needs to be tighter. In short, you must learn to pay more attention to the details.
entries.fr: Malheureusement, je ne peux pas livrer tes créations au client car elles ne sont pas aux normes de notre atelier. Les pièces métalliques ne sont pas bien fixées, les revers sont mal faits, leur forme est bizarre par endroits et elles dégagent une odeur... particulière.
entries.ja:
でも、金具の埋め込みは甘いし、

entries.en: These articles aren't quite fit to be placed into the customer's hands, but they can be salvaged. You have done your part well enough─I will see to the rest.

entries.fr: Tu ne vas pas être capable de rectifier tout ça assez vite, je vais donc m'en occuper. En contrepartie, je te donne un autre travail.
entries.ja:
「フェン・イル」の品にするには不十分ね。
仕方ないわ、アタシが手直ししておくから、
その間に、アンタは、別の仕事を頼まれてくれる？

entries.en: In the meantime, I would have you attend to something else. It is an important duty, and one that is all too often overlooked by artisans. Namely, taking responsibility for falling short of expectations.
entries.fr: Je te charge d'annoncer à notre client, Sosobati, que sa commande va avoir du retard. Fais-lui tes plus plates excuses, et tu as intérêt à être convaincant.

これも、ひとりの職人として、重要な仕事よ。
仕事をほっぽって逃げ出すようなヤツには任せられない、
あんただからできること。

entries.en: In the guild's reception area you will find an Ul'dahn gentleman named Sosobati, one of our regular customers. It is he who placed the order for the caligae and choker. I would have you go to him and kneel in apology for the delay.
entries.macro: In the guild's reception area you will find an Ul'dahn gentleman named Sosobati, one of our regular customers. It is he who placed the order for the caligae and choker. I would have you go to him and <colortype(500)><edgecolortype(501)>kneel<edgecolortype(0)><colortype(0)> in apology for the delay.
entries.fr: J'ose croire que tu n'es pas du genre à te défiler devant tes responsabilités, et que tu t'acquitteras de cette tâche comme tout artisan qui se respecte.
entries.ja:

誠心誠意、敬意をもって謝ってらっしゃい。

entries.en: My son's nameday is fast approaching, so I thought I would gift him the finest protectives money can buy─and none are finer in all the realm than Fen-Yll!
entries.macro: My son's nameday is fast approaching, so I thought I would gift him the finest protectives money can buy─and none are finer in all the realm than Fen<-->Yll!
entries.fr: J'ai commandé un équipement tout neuf pour mon fils. J'attends avec impatience la livraison.
entries.ja:
今回は、我が愛息子のために、
一級の防具を整えてやろうと思ってね。
こうして、完成を待ちわびているというわけだよ。

おわっ！？
なんだね、どうしたんだね！？

entries.en: What's that? My order is delayed, you say? Is that all? Hah hah hah! And there I was thinking something terrible had happened!

entries.fr: ... Ah, vous êtes de l'Atelier Fen-Yll. Vous n'allez pas pouvoir me livrer à la date prévue, dites-vous.
entries.ja:
…………ふむ。
依頼していたと
の納品が遅れる、と。
entries.jaMacro:
…………ふむ。
依頼していたと
の納品が遅れる、と。
entries.speaker: SOSOBATI

entries.en: It's quite all right, truly. I came here precisely because the Leatherworkers' Guild has never compromised on quality. This trifling delay only confirms to me that the principle still endures. Anyway, it is very kind of you to bring me word.
entries.macro: It's quite all right, truly. I came here precisely <italic(1)>because<italic(0)> the Leatherworkers' Guild has never compromised on quality. This trifling delay only confirms to me that the principle still endures. Anyway, it is very kind of you to bring me word.
entries.fr: Écoutez, je préfère que vous preniez un peu plus de temps pour peaufiner l'équipement plutôt que de me vendre des produits défectueux. Je reconnais bien là l'exigence de qualité de l'Atelier, et c'est tout à votre honneur que de vous excuser ainsi.
entries.ja:

entries.en: I daresay the guildmaster sees promise in you. Why else would she consider your work worthy of her personal attention? She is famous for having cut up far more experienced leatherworkers' efforts for scraps─and that before their very eyes!
entries.fr: Je comprends mieux, en effet. Geva doit vous avoir à la bonne si elle vous envoie faire des excuses au nom de l'Atelier.
entries.ja:
なるほど、なるほど。
君はずいぶんゲヴァに気に入られているみたいだね。

entries.en: As for encouraging you to come and apologize... Some may think that Geva goes too far, but it is simply her way of educating her own on the finer points of business. As a native of Ul'dah, I may say with some confidence that it is an education worth enduring.
entries.fr: Vous n'avez pas l'air convaincu, pourtant elle vous a offert la chance d'entrer directement en contact avec un client. C'est un premier pas pour se faire connaître, vous savez. Les gens préfèrent généralement confier leur travail aux artisans qu'ils connaissent.
entries.ja:
客に謝罪に行かせるなんて、乱暴なようだけど、
こうやって顔なじみの客に革細工師を紹介するのは
彼女なりの気遣いだ。

entries.en: Well, it has been a pleasure to meet a rising star of the Leatherworkers' Guild. And that is no hollow flattery I speak.
